changed.title: A weighted cover of guard-stop pairs gives the exact feedback menu budget
changed.statement:
∀ h : Nat, 0 < h →
  let bit := fun (u j : Nat) =>
    xor (u.testBit j) (!(u.testBit (j+1)) && u.testBit (j+2))
  let reply := fun u : Nat =>
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.range h, if bit u j then 2^j else 0
  let fiber := fun z : Nat =>
    (Finset.range (2^(h+2))).filter (fun u => reply u = z)
  let dist := fun (Q : List (Nat × Nat)) (u v : Nat) =>
    (Q.filter (fun p => bit (u ^^^ p.1) p.2 != bit (v ^^^ p.1) p.2)).length
  let mask := fun (top r : Nat) => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (r+1), 2^(top-2*i)
  let six := fun (r s : Nat) =>
    let a := mask h r
    let b := 2^(h+1)
    let c := mask (h-1) s
    [a, b, a ^^^ b, b ^^^ c, (a ^^^ b) ^^^ c, a ^^^ c]
  let wt := fun (Q : List (Nat × Nat)) (v : Nat) =>
    (Q.filter (fun p => xor
      (v.testBit (p.2+1) && p.1.testBit (p.2+2))
      (v.testBit (p.2+2) && p.1.testBit (p.2+1)))).length
  let replies := Finset.range (2^h)
  let m := h/2
  let n := (h-1)/2
  ∀ (menu : Finset (List (Nat × Nat))) (b D target : Nat),
    (∀ Q ∈ menu, ∀ p ∈ Q, p.2 < h) →
    let good := fun (z : Nat) (Q : List (Nat × Nat)) =>
      (((fiber z).product (fiber z)).filter
        (fun uv => uv.1 ≠ uv.2 ∧ dist Q uv.1 uv.2 < D)).card = 0
    (∃ pick : Nat → List (Nat × Nat), replies.image pick ⊆ menu ∧
      (replies.image pick).card ≤ b ∧
      target ≤ (replies.filter (fun z => good z (pick z))).card) ↔
    ∃ bank : Finset (List (Nat × Nat)), bank.Nonempty ∧ bank ⊆ menu ∧ bank.card ≤ b ∧
      target ≤ ∑ r ∈ Finset.range (m+1), ∑ s ∈ Finset.range (n+1),
        if (bank.filter (fun Q => (six r s).all (fun v => decide (D ≤ wt Q v)) = true)).Nonempty
        then 2^(h-(min (r+1) m + min (s+1) n)) else 0
changed.unlocks: reduces the choice of a limited feedback menu to weighted coverage on quadratically many guard pairs
changed.context: Back-substitute from the two tail bits. The four strips differ by the six listed masks; expanding shifted comparisons gives their weights. A list covers a guard pair precisely when every weight reaches D. A stop fixes min(r+1,m) bits in a lane; the two lanes are disjoint. Sum the multiplicities of covered pairs. The image of any policy is a cover of its successes. Choose a covering list per type, with a default elsewhere. A smaller-circuit companion cannot exist because the budget counts distinct lists. Allow 60 to 120 minutes.

changed.title: One signed trace counts arbitrary parity reports on equally spaced cyclic sensors
changed.statement:
∀ (k r m q s d : Nat), 4 ≤ r → 2 ≤ q → 0 < s → k = q*s → s ≤ d → d < 2*s →
  let u := d-s
  let rot := fun (h w : Nat) =>
    ((w <<< (h % k)) ||| (w >>> (k - h % k))) % 2^k
  let step := fun (w : Nat) =>
    (List.range k).foldl (fun acc i => acc ||| ((xor (w.testBit i)
      (!(w.testBit ((i+1)%k)) && w.testBit ((i+2)%k))).toNat <<< i)) 0
  let state := fun (col : Bool) (w name : Nat) (c : Fin r → Fin (2^k)) =>
    let g := if col then 2 else 1
    (List.finRange r).foldl (fun x j =>
      step (x ^^^ rot g x ^^^ rot (k-g) x) ^^^
        rot (if col then 3*(j.val+1)+1 else 2*j.val) w ^^^ (c j).val)
      (rot (if col then 3 else 1) w ^^^ name)
  let reach := fun col : Bool => if col then 7*r-2 else 5*r-3
  let delay := fun col : Bool => if col then 3*r+1 else 2*r-2
  let sign := fun b : Bool => if b then (-1 : ℤ) else 1
  let bits := fun (a x : Nat) => (List.range a).map (fun i => x.testBit i)
  let sched := fun (c : Fin r → Fin (2^k)) =>
    (List.finRange r).flatMap (fun j => bits k (c j).val)
  ∃ C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit,
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo C ∧
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack (3*k+2*r*k+q+m*q+m+(k+1)) C ∧
    C.size ≤ 2^44*(k+r+m+5)^16*(2^(s-1+u)+2^(3*u)) ∧
    ∀ (nr nc : Fin (2^k)) (cr cc : Fin r → Fin (2^k)) (off : Fin k) (bank : Fin q → Bool),
      let p := fun i : Fin q => (off.val+i.val*s)%k
      let sensor := fun (i : Fin q) (w : Nat) =>
        (state (bank i) w (if bank i then nc.val else nr.val)
          (if bank i then cc else cr)).testBit ((p i + delay (bank i))%k)
      let valid := ∀ i, reach (bank i) ≤ d
      let K := fun (i : Fin q) (a b : Fin (2^u)) =>
        ∑ z : Fin (2^(s-1)),
          if z.val % 2^u = a.val then
            let h := fun (t : Bool) => sensor i (rot (p i)
              ((z.val <<< 1) ||| (t.toNat <<< s) ||| (b.val <<< (s+1))))
            if h false = h true then (0 : ℤ) else sign (h false)
          else 0
      let D := Matrix.trace ((List.ofFn
        (fun i : Fin q => (K i : Matrix (Fin (2^u)) (Fin (2^u)) ℤ))).prod)
      (valid → ∀ y : Fin q → Bool,
        ((Nat.card {w : Fin (2^k) // ∀ i, sensor i w.val = y i}) : ℤ) =
          (2 : ℤ)^(k-q) + sign ((List.ofFn y).foldl xor false) * D) ∧
      ∀ (A : Fin m → Fin (2^q)) (v : Fin m → Bool) (t : Fin (2^(k+1))),
        let obs := fun (w : Nat) (j : Fin m) => (List.finRange q).foldl
          (fun b i => xor b ((A j).val.testBit i.val && sensor i w)) false
        let hits := Nat.card {w : Fin (2^k) // ∀ j, obs w.val j = v j}
        let masks := (List.finRange m).flatMap (fun j => bits q (A j).val)
        C.eval (bits k nr.val ++ bits k nc.val ++ sched cr ++ sched cc ++ bits k off.val ++
          List.ofFn bank ++ masks ++ List.ofFn v ++ bits (k+1) t.val) =
            decide (valid ∧ t.val ≤ hits)
changed.unlocks: Prices arbitrary overlapping parity tests on a cyclic schedule after the first shared pivot, using a single signed trace of dimension determined by the exterior overlap. For fixed spacing the gate count stays polynomial in the number of sensors and reports.
changed.context: Unroll the final injection. A selected sensor is its pivot xor a tail on its own exterior block, next pivot and first u=d-s bits of the next block. Fix the exterior. Proper nonempty masks cancel by a pivot flip. The full character factors into signed unary differences. Sum exterior words grouped by their low u bits and close the ordered product by a trace. Replay each local pair once. Multiply q width-2^u matrices. Binary elimination on the report masks gives consistency, rank and the two parity-class sizes. Compare the signed total to the threshold.
